name: Esoterorist
description: History is written by the winners, unless you were born on the losing side. Whether you were a child soldier or a warden from the wrong part of town, you've decided to take justice into your own hands.

name: Glitchblade
description: A rogue cyber agent with both an experimental tech-blade and advanced skills in evasion, stealth, and survival. You've gone off-grid after being burned by your handler.

name: Wirehead
description: You grew up surrounded by circuits, building and repairing drones, mechs, and other machinery. You are one with the machine.

name: Astromancer
description: You spent your whole life logged into cyberspace. Your knowledge in code and megabytes allows you to manipulate the digital forces of the Network. (MIND focus)

name: Desperado
description: The ruthless in control of space outlaws and renegades of the far world. You act on instinct — a born survivor outside of the restraining grip of galactic law. (GRACE focus)

name: Chromeskin
description: The majority of your body has been replaced with synthetic DNI. Hardwired and enhanced implants provide an edge over the standard soldier. You are the pinnacle of cybernetics. (VIGOR focus)
